item.title: Dhurandhar 2 USA Advance Booking Day 1: Ranveer Singh starrer crosses USD 100K mark in 2 days flat, 16 days prior to release
item.description: The advance booking of Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge is hinting towards a record-breaking start in the USA premieres for a Hindi film. As of March 3, 10 AM, the Ranveer Singh starrer recorded an advance of USD 67,000 for the premiere day alone. The movie has sold around 4000 tickets in 300-plus shows across 220 locations in the USA. The opening day sales of Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, including premieres, crossed the USD 100K mark. This is a solid start for a Hindi film advance in overseas territory.
